methodology: 25 stable signed seeds (125 in deep mode), Classic control, three challenges, three charters, both ascensions and four prescribed strategies. No economy tuning, optimization or hidden rescue. All runs use the actual atomic world. Manual command counts exclude AdvanceDay; policy submissions are counted separately. Gross material margin excludes wages, transport operating costs and depreciation; held basis is not liquidation value.
